text_block_list.text: One day, while preparing for training――
choice_data_list: Hm? Did something drop... A horseshoe?

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
...Haaah, nothing... Where on earth did I 
cast that shoe...?
choice_data_list: Is this horseshoe yours, by any chance?
Is this horseshoe yours, by any chance?

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: Ah, that's right!

The horseshoe belonged to Win Variation. 
It was worn down, so it made sense that it 
had slipped off.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Looks like she threw a shoe during 
warm-ups... Even though we just had them 
reshod the day before yesterday.
choice_data_list:
The day before yesterday?! That much wear 
and tear in just two days?!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. They wear down so fast and get all 
loose...

The wear on the horseshoe was completely 
even. In other words, it wasn't due to an 
odd running habit, but purely worn down 
through honest training.

Looking closely, her horseshoes were 
firmly set on well-maintained, yet 
thoroughly worn-in shoes.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Heheh, it's not like I'm some kind 
of super-talented Umamusume or anything.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
This academy is practically crawling with 
Umamusume called geniuses and monsters, 
isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Everyone around me is a monster like that, 
too... I get reminded of it every single 
day.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
To win against competitors like that... 
there's nothing to do but give it 
everything through sheer hard work.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
—Hard work will always be rewarded. If I 
can't win... it's because I haven't worked 
hard enough.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
I... still need to work harder than anyone 
else.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
If everyone else wears down their 
horseshoes in two weeks, then I'll run 
twice as much and do it faster.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
...Even so, I still haven't caught up. 
That's why I have to do more, much more――!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I don't mean I want it to wear out 
quickly! I try to take good care of it so 
it lasts as long as possible!
choice_data_list:
I can tell just by looking at your shoes 
and horseshoes.

text_block_list.text:
Shoes and horseshoes reveal how an 
Umamusume runs. Looking at her horseshoe, 
what became clear wasâ
choice_data_list:
You're thoroughly dedicating yourself to 
building speed.

You're thoroughly dedicating yourself to 
building speed.

choice_data_list:
You're thoroughly dedicating yourself to

You're thoroughly dedicating yourself to 
building speed.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: I-Isn't that, like, totally insane...?

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Heheh... I'm so happy! Truth is, I've been 
feeling that way too—

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
It brings me a sense of peace. Watching 
these tools grow worn through daily, 
devoted use.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
...Because it's proof of all our hard 
work.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: ! That was insanely encouraging, sir!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
B-Bingo! Wait, seriously? You can tell all 
that just from a horseshoe?

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Haaah... Trainer, you really are 
amazing...!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Still... that must be because you worked 
so hard on your studies, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
All right! I'll do my best too! So I can 
become just like you, Trainer!
